fact: In January 2025 the Ministry of Health stated that SIS-MA on DHIS2 is the country's main reporting platform since 2016, but that only 340 of 1,886 public facilities enter data directly, with a data quality index of 70% at district and 63% at facility level.
title: Plano de melhoria de qualidade de dados (PMQD) 2025-2029
